rationale:
Positives: The agent verified identity using full name + zip, matched the order to the authenticated user, gathered item preferences, summarized the exact changes, obtained explicit confirmation before submitting the exchange, and used the exchange tool on the correct order. The requested items (keyboard: clicky/no-backlight full-size; thermostat: Google Assistant/black) were the ones submitted in the exchange, and the exchange tool returned successfully.

Failures: The agent stated product availability/options that were not supported by the product-details tool output: it introduced an 80% RGB clicky keyboard variant (item ID 2299424241) not shown by the tool and suggested a full-size white-backlight option without confirming switch type consistency (tool shows the white-backlight full-size variant as tactile). More critically, after submitting the exchange, the agent stated a precise refund amount ($16.63) without any evidence from the tools showing that calculation. Stating unsupported details violates the policy requirement not to invent facts and to provide correct final information. Due to these unsupported claims, the interaction does not meet the pass bar despite otherwise correct process steps.
